requirements.text: The analyzer reports diagnostics for types with [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)], as it did in 3.1.0
requirements.quote: The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true. This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.

requirements.kind: implicit constraint (reviewers' reading of the issue, not stated in it)
requirements.text: Types that do get a generated formatter keep their behaviour: the change is on the shared collection path, so they must be covered too
requirements.quote: (implicit) fixing suppressed types must not change generated ones
